sheets.title: SWE Roadmap
sheets.subtitle: Software Engineering / SDE track: strengthen coding and CS fundamentals, then ship reliable software.

values.learn: Syntax, methods, arrays, strings, collections, generics, exceptions and clean code.
Arrays, strings, hash maps, stacks/queues, linked lists, binary search, recursion, trees, heaps, graphs, greedy, backtracking, DP; explain time/space.
Encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, composition and SOLID basics.
Keys, normalization, joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, transactions, indexes and query plans.
Processes/threads, concurrency, deadlocks, memory, virtual memory, scheduling and synchronization.
HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, TCP vs UDP, TLS, cookies, REST and status codes.
Semantic HTML, responsive layouts, DOM, ES6+, promises, async/await, error handling and browser devtools.
Components, props/state, hooks, routing, forms, accessibility, API loading/error states and reusable components.
Routing, middleware, validation, pagination, error handling, authentication, authorization and API docs.
Controllers, services, repositories, DTOs, validation, dependency injection, JPA and security basics.
Schema design, relationships, indexes, migrations, aggregation, pagination and transactions.
Branching, clean commits, pull requests, resolving conflicts, issues, README and meaningful history.
Unit, integration and API tests; test validation/auth/error paths; logs, breakpoints and reproducible bug reports.
Dockerfile, env vars, build/test pipeline, health checks, secrets, logs and rollback basics.
Caching, queues, load balancing, rate limits, database trade-offs, reliability and observability.
Document roles, API contracts, DB schema, security, error states, tests, seed data, deployment, architecture diagram and demo.
values.resource: Use existing project as main SWE case study.

values.learn: Timed DSA practice; explain trade-offs, a bug fixed, a design choice, testing strategy and project impact.

sheets.title: AI/ML Roadmap
sheets.subtitle: AI/ML track: learn data and classical ML first, then choose deep learning or GenAI/RAG based on target roles.

values.learn: Functions, collections, modules, virtual environments, exceptions, notebooks and reusable code.
Vectors, matrices, dot products, matrix multiplication, norms and embedding intuition.
Distributions, expectation/variance, conditional probability, Bayes, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests and correlation vs causation.
Array operations, missing data, duplicates, joins, groupby, visualization, outliers and data-leakage awareness.
Joins, aggregation, CTEs, window functions, data-quality checks and basic indexing.
Linear/logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, gradient boosting, kNN and SVM intuition.
K-means, hierarchical clustering, PCA, anomaly detection and when to use each.
Imputation, encoding, scaling, pipelines, class imbalance, train/validation/test split and leakage prevention.
Confusion matrix, precision/recall/F1, ROC-AUC, MAE/RMSE, cross-validation, threshold choice and baseline comparison.
Bias/variance, regularization, feature importance, calibration, fairness, limitations and data provenance.
Tensors, layers, activations, loss, backpropagation intuition, optimizers, batch size and epochs.
Tensors, Dataset/DataLoader, model class, training loop, autograd, checkpoints and inference.
Tokenization, attention, embeddings, model/tokenizer loading, inference pipelines and model cards.
Secure API-key handling, schema validation, retries, timeouts, streaming, context and token/cost awareness.
Parse documents, chunk with metadata, embed, retrieve top-k, assemble context, generate grounded answers and cite sources.
Chroma/FAISS/pgvector, similarity search, metadata filters, hybrid search basics, recall and citation correctness.
Golden test set, groundedness/relevance, prompt injection, privacy, untrusted retrieved text, bounded tools and abstention.
Pydantic validation, REST endpoints, inference, error handling, docs, versioning and health checks.
Environment configuration, reproducible data/model versions, logging, latency monitoring and drift awareness.
Document problem, data source, baseline, split strategy, metrics, error analysis, limitations and reproducible steps.
Expose inference through an API and integrate into a simple interface; include tests, usage limits and failure states.

sheets.title: AI + SWE Integration
sheets.subtitle: Combined development track: use software engineering to build reliable products and AI/ML to add a measured, testable capability.

values.learn: Choose a bounded feature (e.g. healthcare resource demand forecast or document Q&A); define users, inputs, outputs and success metric.
values.resource: Try a focused Swasthya Setu feature.

values.learn: Responsive form/results UI, loading/empty/error states, accessible controls and API integration.
Validate requests, enforce auth/roles, store data, rate-limit expensive calls and return consistent errors.
Design schema, indexes and migrations; validate/version input data; protect private data.
Build a simple rule/statistical baseline, define evaluation metrics, compare improvements and record limitations.
Use a separate FastAPI service for custom models or securely call a hosted LLM API; validate inputs/outputs.
Ingest documents, chunk, embed, retrieve relevant sections, cite sources and say when evidence is missing.
values.resource: Only if document search solves the problem.

values.learn: Define request/response schemas, timeouts, retries, error codes, service auth and safe fallbacks.
Track latency, request failures and AI cost; cache safe results; show fallback when model is unavailable.
Keep secrets server-side, limit access, validate model outputs, treat retrieved text as untrusted and minimize sensitive data.
Test frontend/API/service boundaries, malformed input, no-result cases, grounding cases and authorization.
Measure app correctness/availability and model quality (task metrics, groundedness and human review).
Deploy frontend, backend and AI service; configure env vars, health checks, logs, versioning and rollback.
Publish architecture/data-flow diagram, API docs, test instructions, limitations, screenshots, demo URL and setup README.
Connect a measured prediction service to the backend; label demo predictions and document dataset/model limitations.
values.resource: Do not present it as validated clinical advice.

values.learn: Upload approved docs, retrieve passages, answer with citations, evaluate grounding and show an abstain state.
Explain model choice, baseline comparison, data design, API boundaries, security, testing and deployment.
